source.title: M.B.F.D. A.L.S. TRANSPORT VEHICLE WEEKLY INVENTORY
notes: Transcribed from a photo of the paper sheet "M.B.F.D. A.L.S. TRANSPORT VEHICLE WEEKLY INVENTORY", Revised April 2021. The sha256 is of that photo.

Three printed columns read left to right: DRUGS, I.V./NEEDLES and AIRWAYS/OXYGEN; then AIRWAYS/OXYGEN Cont., INTUBATION/SUCTION and TRAUMA SUPPLIES; then TRAUMA SUPPLIES Cont., PPE - DECON, LifePack 15 SUPPLIES and MISCELLANEOUS.
The "Cont." headings continue the section above them and are merged into one section each (Airways / Oxygen, Trauma Supplies); item order is the sheet reading order.

AMOUNT is the par the vehicle should carry (min_text / min_qty / min_unit). "Fill if <" is the level under which the item is refilled (flags.fill_if_text / fill_if_qty). NEED is blank on the sheet and is what the member enters on the form.
Values are kept as printed, including mixed units such as "1 pack" with "1 Roll" (EKG paper) and "1 pack" with "2 Razors" (disposable razors).
The ET tube lines go 6.0, 6.5, 7.5, 8.0, 8.5, 9.0 on the sheet (there is no 7.0 line).

items.label: ET Tube 7.5
items.notes: The sheet goes from 6.5 straight to 7.5; there is no 7.0 line.
